purpose: Plants secrets through the real secret helper, exercises the helper and a consuming tool, and scans every place a secret could leak for any trace of it.
title: Secrets stay in the Keychain and are never shown

testCases.description: A secret stored in a temporary Keychain is handed to a tool three times through core/tools/secret.py, with the floor and a failed lookup in the mix; afterwards it is in the Keychain and in no file of the owner's folder, Squire's home or the transcript, as text, base64 or hex.
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/secrets.test.js::a secret used through the helper across normal work is in the Keychain and nowhere else

testCases.description: The helper hands the Keychain secret to a tool that prints it, and neither output holds it; with the Keychain locked, lacking the secret or unavailable, the helper stops without a prompt, runs nothing, tells the owner what to do and never uses the decoys in a file or the environment.
testCases.testPointer: tests/acceptance/secrets.test.js::the helper hands the secret to the tool without showing it, and stops with directions when the Keychain cannot supply it
